name: Leander Didrik
source:
The main character of this visual novel. 

He is an atheist and he has an IQ of 169. 

He is studying imaginary numbers, at university, as part of his degree. 

His mother and father are both dead at the start of the story.

**Please Note**: This character's corruption does not involve a sex change. He remains sexually a male throughout the corruption process.

[spoiler]His bimbo name, given to him by GeeDee, is Lee-Ann.[spoiler]
